{{recipe}} [[Category:Recipes using strawberry]] [[Category:Recipes using hazelnut]] 
[[Category:Recipes using chocolate]]
[[Category:Recipes for dessert]]
== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] semisweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]], melted using a [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] hazelnut-flavored [[Cookbook:Syrup|syrup]]
* ¼ cup white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] pure [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla extract]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 50 [[Cookbook:Strawberry|strawberries]], hulled
* 50 bamboo or wooden [[Cookbook:Skewer|toothpicks]]
* Chopped [[Cookbook:Hazelnut|hazelnuts]], [[Cookbook:Pecan|pecans]], [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]], or [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]] (optional)
* Crushed gingersnap cookies (optional)

== Procedure ==
#Combine melted chocolate, syrup, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
#If using cookies or nuts, place them in a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie plate]].
#Add strawberries to chocolate mixture and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] to coat. If using nuts or cookies, roll strawberries in them.
#Insert a toothpick into the side of each fruit and refrigerate until coating sets. 
#Serve chilled.
